text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hassan meets Libyan Secretary of Unity Affairs Jomaa al-Fezzani.
- General Confederation of Moroccan businesses organises on December 5 a two-day seminar on Euro-Mediterranean economic development.
- Morocco and Spain to connect electricity grids in May.
- Moroccan Non-Governmental Organisations vow to launch an awareness campaign against corruption and set a national day to be celebrated on January 6.
